title: sec(sophon-sdk-go): CI does not run govulncheck or go mod verify
description: .github/workflows/verify.yml runs go test/build/vet and a go mod tidy + git diff tidiness check, but does NOT run govulncheck or go mod verify. Checklist (Supply-chain): govulncheck clean of P0/P1 at HEAD must be gated, and CI should run go mod verify. Both pass locally today (govulncheck: no vulnerabilities; go mod verify: all modules verified) but are not enforced in CI, so a future advisory or checksum mismatch would not fail the build. Fix: add a govulncheck step (golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck) and a go mod verify step to verify.yml. Mirror upstream. Parent: sophon-sdk-go-bv5.

title: sec(sophon-sdk-go): Debug mode logs the Authorization: Bearer header
description: client.go:262 callAPI uses httputil.DumpRequestOut(request, true) when cfg.Debug is true, dumping ALL request headers including Authorization: Bearer <key> to the log. Checklist (published SDKs): the default logger must never include Authorization/X-Api-Key even at DEBUG. Opt-in (Debug defaults false) and this is OpenAPI-Generator-emitted code (DO NOT EDIT), so remediation belongs UPSTREAM in the sophon-api generator template (redact Authorization in the dump). Do not hand-patch generated client.go in this repo — it is overwritten on regen. Parent: sophon-sdk-go-bv5.

title: sec(sophon-sdk-go): download helper is an open redirect follower with no B2 host allowlist
description: helpers/downloads.go:33 DownloadOutput uses http.DefaultClient.Do, which follows up to 10 redirects to ANY host. adapters.go GetOutputURL follows the API 302 and returns Location without validating it points at an allowlisted Backblaze host. Checklist (Sophon-platform protocols): output download 302 should follow exactly one redirect and only to allowlisted hosts (*.backblazeb2.com / f00X.backblazeb2.com), never an open follower. No Bearer is attached to the download GET so no key leak, but content-spoof/SSRF-style risk if the redirect chain is manipulated. Fix: use a non-following client, validate the host against a B2 allowlist before GET, cap at one redirect. Source of truth is upstream sophon-api api/sdk/helpers/go/ — mirror the fix there. Parent: sophon-sdk-go-bv5.
